prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were usually too high compared to noise-corrected measurements in four of the five rounds, though round 5 was slightly under-predicted.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.
Evidence is still thin for sign-in copy changes, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.
Sign-in reordering changes average +2.7% after noise correction across three tests, with two tests proving helpful (won) and one showing no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, copy: -0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.7% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Experience: Redesign the path selection screen into a story scroll layout that showcases default versus custom pet generation with rich visual previews. (why: Path selection drops 23.8% of users with an 8s median time; introducing visual narrative cards helps users make a confident path choice.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Pre-Adoption Sign-In Shift: Move sign-in to take place immediately after path selection and before pet customization. (why: Sign-in reordering changes yield average +2.7% performance across previous tests, and placing sign-in earlier secures user state prior to rendering assets.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Trait Customization Screen: Insert a dedicated companion trait selection screen right before photo upload to define personality and visual style early. (why: Adoption is the largest drop-off point during pet creation (60.9% conversion) and support receives complaints about custom pets looking or behaving wrong.)
3: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Details: Display active progress updates and live time estimate indicators on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting screen takes a long median time (201s) and high mean (2336s), causing uncertainty about whether pet creation is stalling.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Display Diagnostic Flow: Add an integrated screen check flow on the final onboarding step to verify overlay permissions and multi-monitor visibility. (why: Finish stage converts at only 64.8% and support received multiple emails reporting that pets do not show on the desktop or the app fails to open.)
5: [adoption, layout] Split View Companion Selector: Switch the pet selection screen to a split-screen view featuring interactive previews alongside companion summary details. (why: Adoption has a heavy drop-off (60.9% conversion) and a high mean time (1017s); a side-by-side comparison speeds up decision making.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync Guarantee Note: Add explicit reassurance copy on the sign-in screen explaining that account creation permanently protects adopt status and companion data. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
7: [home, notification] Ready Desktop Alert System: Enable optional background notifications while pet assets render so users can safely minimize the app. (why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s (nearly 39 minutes); users benefit from knowing when it is safe to background the app.)
8: [choose_path, hint] Onboarding Time Expectation Hint: Add an estimated setup duration hint to the path selection screen so users know setup involves a quick generation process. (why: Mean finish time is 5815s overall due to deep asset creation; setting clear expectations upfront reduces early abandonment.)
9: [finish, copy] Companion Control Primer Copy: Update final screen body text with direct instructions on how to interact with, hide, or trigger desktop actions for the pet. (why: Support logged 3 separate tickets from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing onboarding.)
